primitives.name: Source Freshness Indicator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # BUILD-SITE-016: Source freshness badge system ## Duplicate Gate duplicate_check_status: EXTENSION matched_existing_ids: BUILD-GV2-020, BUILD-112 relation_to_existing: Extends existing design/help/growth/trust work with route-level site implementation.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_{fresh}': 'timestamp of last verified content update (seconds since Unix epoch)', 'T_{max}': 'maximum allowable freshness window (seconds)'}
primitives.assumptions: Content freshness is inversely proportional to time elapsed since last update; user perception of trust correlates with temporal proximity to source validation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When t_{fresh} > T_{max}, indicator transitions from green to amber, signaling potential staleness.

layer2.mapping: The badge's color-coded status mirrors GSI's probabilistic confidence score over source validity, where green = P(valid|source) > 0.95, amber = 0.8 < P(valid|source) ≤ 0.95.
layer2.telemetry: Badge color change frequency, user dwell time on badge-enabled routes

primitives.name: Trust Signal Hierarchy
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Design Direction Premium sports intelligence command center: cinematic but fast, high contrast, calm reading states, strong hierarchy, sports-native signal language, no casino/tout feel.
primitives.assumptions: Visual hierarchy directly influences perceived trustworthiness; higher contrast and clear typography increase signal-to-noise ratio in trust communication.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S_{signal} < 0.3, H_{trust} drops below threshold requiring remediation.

layer2.mapping: GSE computes H_{trust} as a weighted sum of badge visibility, font size, and contrast ratio, derived from GSI's inferred trust metrics.
layer2.telemetry: User interaction heatmap around badge elements, scroll depth post-badge exposure

primitives.name: Legal Compliance Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / Compliance Boundary No live sportsbook/casino affiliate links, no guaranteed wins, no irresponsible gambling copy, no minors targeting, no legal claims without approval.
primitives.assumptions: Compliance violations introduce legal risk that scales with content exposure; risk mitigation requires real-time filtering of prohibited language or links.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If C_{risk} > 0.7, L_{comply} falls below acceptable threshold triggering automated review.

layer2.mapping: GSI enforces L_{comply} by cross-referencing content against regulatory lexicons; GSE applies this as a binary gate during route rendering.
layer2.telemetry: Automated content scan pass/fail rate, flagged terms per route
